metadata.description: Red tiles form an asymmetric bandura body, neck and fan of strings. Blue ground slows the craft; red ground is lethal until captured. Twin flank corridors surround the motif, with sheltered harbours along the lower route. 5 yellow bouncers, two outer patrols and 9 island-contour patrols guard the field. No horizontal barrier bars. Start at bottom center and reveal 75%.
